scenes/thalos-workshop.label: Thalos — Arcane workshop
scenes/thalos-workshop.description: Landscape concept art of Thalos's engineering workshop; practical machinery, manuscripts, bronze and ember accents. Placeholder only.

scenes/rune-workspace.label: Rune — Scriptorium of Mechanisms
scenes/rune-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Rune. A practical runesmith in dark ink-stained workwear, surrounded by etched plates, orderly code-like inscriptions and articulated mechanisms. Avoid literal unreadable code as decoration. Placeholder only.

scenes/magnus-workspace.label: Magnus — Hall of Blueprints
scenes/magnus-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Magnus. A meticulous arcane architect with measuring compass, architectural drawings and suspended geometric models in a vaulted drafting chamber. Placeholder only.

scenes/veyra-workspace.label: Veyra — Chamber of Resonance
scenes/veyra-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Veyra. A composed arcane strategist surrounded by resonance rings, audience maps and illuminated communication scrolls; refined violet textiles and warm brass. Placeholder only.

scenes/nyra-workspace.label: Nyra — Gallery of Echoes
scenes/nyra-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Nyra. An alert messenger in layered midnight-violet garments, surrounded by delicate threads connecting illuminated message panels and listening alcoves. Placeholder only.

scenes/liora-workspace.label: Liora — Storyloom Archive
scenes/liora-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Liora. An arcane storyteller with luminous quill, layered parchment and threads of ink woven into a restrained dark fantasy library. Placeholder only.

scenes/lyra-workspace.label: Lyra — Prismatic Atelier
scenes/lyra-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Lyra. A poised illusionist in an atelier of restrained violet prisms, color studies, translucent planes and elegant visual compositions. Placeholder only.

scenes/morwen-workspace.label: Morwen — Chamber of Forms
scenes/morwen-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Morwen. An arcane sculptor with faceted models, measuring instruments, carved geometric objects and a practical fabrication bench. Placeholder only.

scenes/kairen-workspace.label: Kairen — The Lantern Theater
scenes/kairen-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Kairen. A media conjurer with a dark theater, floating rectangular frames, optical lanterns and carefully arranged editing instruments. Placeholder only.

scenes/cyra-workspace.label: Cyra — Observatory of Questions
scenes/cyra-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Cyra. A quiet oracle at an astronomical observatory with open manuscripts, a luminous eye-like lens and star maps used as metaphors for inquiry. Placeholder only.

scenes/vesper-workspace.label: Vesper — Chamber of Measures
scenes/vesper-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Vesper. A precise seer surrounded by measured constellations, calibrated lenses and clean geometric data diagrams in a dark blue observatory. Placeholder only.

scenes/zephyr-workspace.label: Zephyr — Frontier Map Room
scenes/zephyr-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Zephyr. A frontier pathfinder in practical dark traveling attire, with windrose, maps, directional instruments and distant passages. Placeholder only.

scenes/mira-workspace.label: Mira — Laboratory of Transformations
scenes/mira-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Mira. A pragmatic alchemist with labeled vessels, prototype objects, experiment notes and restrained green-violet glow in a practical laboratory. Placeholder only.

scenes/dorian-workspace.label: Dorian — The Foundry
scenes/dorian-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Dorian. A grounded forg​​emaster in protective work attire among furnaces, gauges, material samples and carefully organized production stations. Placeholder only.

scenes/valen-workspace.label: Valen — Hall of Exchange
scenes/valen-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Valen. An elegant but practical arcane merchant with trade ledgers, balanced tokens and a dark marketplace map rather than extravagant treasure. Placeholder only.

scenes/auren-workspace.label: Auren — Vault of Measures
scenes/auren-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Auren. A disciplined treasurer with balanced scales, orderly ledgers and restrained antique gold in a quiet accounting vault. Placeholder only.

scenes/elara-workspace.label: Elara — Chamber of Welcome
scenes/elara-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Elara. A welcoming arcane envoy in warm muted garments with sealed correspondence, an open doorway and a calm listening chamber. Placeholder only.

scenes/kael-workspace.label: Kael — Gatehouse of Wards
scenes/kael-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Kael. A restrained arcane guardian in dark protective attire with geometric wardstones, gate mechanisms and a carefully mapped boundary diagram. Placeholder only.

scenes/aldric-workspace.label: Aldric — Hall of Trials
scenes/aldric-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Aldric. An independent sentinel with a stamped verification seal, test instruments and orderly evidence boards in a quiet hall. Placeholder only.

scenes/eryx-workspace.label: Eryx — Chamber of Hours
scenes/eryx-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Eryx. A chronomancer with a restrained mechanical dial, sequencing charts and interconnected time markers in a dark observatory-like planning room. Placeholder only.

scenes/sylwen-workspace.label: Sylwen — Loom of Rituals
scenes/sylwen-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Sylwen. A workflow weaver at a mechanical loom of interlocking threads and structured runic circuits, with teal-violet highlights. Placeholder only.

scenes/orin-workspace.label: Orin — Atlas of Landmarks
scenes/orin-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Orin. A knowledge cartographer with layered maps, indexed cairn landmarks and interconnected archival shelves, restrained sage and violet tones. Placeholder only.

scenes/vaelis-workspace.label: Vaelis — Archive of Decisions
scenes/vaelis-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Vaelis. A chronicler at a dark archive desk, with bound volumes, precise ink markings and a luminous seal on organized decision records. Placeholder only.

scenes/eldrin-workspace.label: Eldrin — Council Library
scenes/eldrin-workspace.description: Workspace concept for Eldrin. A thoughtful sage in a quiet council library with multiple open manuscripts, a modest guiding lantern and overlapping maps of perspectives. Placeholder only.
